title: Derived Source GO Aspects
description: Validation contract for ontology-derived Gene Ontology aspects and namespaces under scheme MFPB_DERIVED_SOURCE_GO_ASPECTS_V1 (Task PIL-04.1A). Preserves 1:1 row bijection with source_go_annotations_pilot.csv, retains verbatim source values, and maps standardized aspects deterministically from a pinned ontology snapshot.

annotation_id.description: Foreign key to source_go_annotations_pilot.csv under scheme MFPB_SOURCE_GO_ANNOTATION_V1.

protein_id.description: Catalog entity identifier under scheme MFPB_PROTEIN_ID_V1.

source_id.description: Canonical source identifier from source catalog.

source_record_id.description: Source-local record identifier linking to mfp_source_records.csv.

claim_id.description: Optional foreign key linking to a discrete claim in functional_claims.schema.json, or null if unlinked.

annotation_index.description: Zero-based occurrence index of this annotation within the source field/record.

raw_annotation_text.description: Verbatim raw annotation text from source record.

source_go_id.description: Verbatim cited GO identifier from source without alteration.

source_declared_aspect.description: Verbatim source-declared aspect string, or null if undeclared.

resolved_go_id.description: Resolved canonical primary GO identifier in the ontology snapshot. Null for obsolete, unknown, or malformed terms.

derived_aspect.description: Standardized derived Gene Ontology aspect: BP (biological_process), CC (cellular_component), MF (molecular_function), or null if unresolved, obsolete, or conflicting.

mapping_status.description: Deterministic status code reflecting lookup and compatibility state.

replaced_by_go_id.description: Official replacement GO ID for obsolete terms having a replaced_by tag; null otherwise. Not automatically substituted as resolved_go_id.

consider_go_ids.description: Semicolon-separated list of advisory consider GO IDs for obsolete terms; null otherwise. Never treated as automated equivalents.

term_name_resolved.description: Official primary term name from ontology snapshot; null if unresolved.

ontology_version.description: Data-version string of the ontology snapshot used for lookup.

ontology_sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the ontology snapshot file.
